title: Silver Beach Resort

services.name: Cabin 1
services.desc: Our Cabins are just what you need for a relaxing getaway with no worries. They have a bathroom and kitchenette with all linens and dishes provided. Beautiful views of Rimrock Lake right from your cabin. All cabins have a campfire pit, and picnic table out front. There is NO Wi-Fi inside the cabins, only in the common areas at the Store and Motel. Cabin 1 has 2 queen beds, along with a foldout Sofa. It contains a bathroom, including a sink, toilet, and shower along with towels. The kitchenette has a microwave, coffee pot, stove/oven, sink, and mini fridge. services.name: Camp sites
services.desc: Want to go back to the basics and feel closer to nature? We have non-hookup sites right on the shores of Rimrock Lake to dip your toes in. As well as plenty of hookup sites for all of your RV needs. There is Restrooms with running water, flushing toilets, coin-operated showers and potable water, located right under the store. As well as Restrooms on the west end of the resort. We have a free dump station on site for any customers to use as needed, for added convenience! Most of our non-hookup sites are located right on the Lake Shore for an amazing experience. All of the sites are surrounded by trees. services.name: Rental Trailers
services.desc: Do you want that camp feeling without all the preparation? We offer trailers to rent, so you can just show up and you are ready to go. Our comfy trailers have all the essentials for you including linens, basic cookware and dishware, and coffee pot. Each trailer is a bit different, please read on for additional details. Trailer 1 has a queen bedroom and a futon. It has the great luxury of that camping feel without the worries. This Trailer has a kitchenette with basic dishes and a bathroom with towels and linens.
